name: io.github.tradinglookup/data
title: TradingLookup open data
description: Prop firm, broker and exchange data plus codes firms issued to us. Read-only, CC BY 4.0.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find prop firms, brokers, crypto exchanges and open datasets on TradingLookup by name or topic. Returns matches with their page address. Use get_facts or get_dataset next.

query.description: A name or topic, for example "FTMO", "CFD loss rates" or "futures prop firm prices".

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: The dated facts TradingLookup publishes for one prop firm, broker or crypto exchange (for example cheapest plan, profit split, platforms), each read from the firm's own pages, with the page to cite.

name.description: The firm's name, for example "Topstep", or its page path from search.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Every open dataset TradingLookup publishes (CC BY 4.0): prop firm prices and rules, CFD loss rates, broker and exchange fees, market calendars and macro series. Returns id, name, page and data date.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: One dataset in full: what it holds, its files with columns and row counts, the download addresses, the licence and how to cite it.

id.description: A dataset id from list_datasets or search.

tools.name: read_rows
tools.description: Rows from one CSV file of a dataset, at most 50 a call. Filter with "where" (column: text the value must contain). Files over 200 KB are not read whole: filter by firm_slug to read one firm, or use the download address in the result.

file.description: File name from get_dataset. Default: the dataset's first CSV file.

where.description: Column name to text; a row is kept when the value contains the text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: get_promo_code
tools.description: The discount code a prop firm issued to TradingLookup, if we hold one: the code, what it gives, the date the firm issued it, the firm's own website and our page for it. Leave "firm" empty to list every code we hold. We only list codes the firm gave us; if we hold none for a firm, it says so.

firm.description: The firm's name, for example "PropXP". Leave empty for every code.

tools.name: find_prop_firms
tools.description: Prop firm plans that cost least to reach a funded account, one plan per firm, from each firm's own pages. Filter by market, account size, country (firms whose own list names it are left out), news-trading rule, platform and budget. Prices are without any promo code; cost_to_funded_usd is price plus any activation fee (our sum). Each result links the firm's facts page to cite.

account_size.description: Account size in USD, for example 50000 or 100000.

country.description: Where the trader lives: a two-letter code ("GB") or a country name. Firms whose own list names it are left out.

news_trading.description: "allowed": the firm says news trading is allowed; "allowed_or_limits": also firms that allow it with limits.

platform.description: Text the firm's platform list must contain, for example "NinjaTrader" or "MT5".

max_cost_usd.description: Most the trader wants to pay to reach funded.

tools.name: get_rule_changes
tools.description: What changed in TradingLookup's record of one prop firm's rules and prices between our weekly reads of its own pages, newest first: old and new value, date, the firm's page and an Internet Archive copy. A row means our recorded value differed between two reads.

since.description: Only changes on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
